experimental_design: quantitative comparison of MCAK vs MCAKS6E phosphomimetic mutant

To compare MCAK and MCAKS6E quantitatively, a workflow that integrated the MaxQuant (v1.5.3.30) for spectra pre-processing, Xi (v1.6.743, ) for crosslinked peptide identification and Skyline (v4.1.0.11717) for MS1-based quantification was used.
